title: Project Overview
content: Xfnite is a building labeling project where workers label roofs and building shapes using satellite maps. Work is flexible and output-based.

title: How to Apply
content: To apply: Complete Hands-on Training tasks (Live Sessions are temporarily stopped), join Orientation, and then start working.

title: Hiring Information
content: Xfnite has limited hiring slots. Applicants must complete training before being allowed to work.

title: Requirements
content: You need a stable internet connection, unlimited data, a PC or laptop with a mouse, and the ability to analyze building shapes.

title: System Requirements
content: Minimum system requirements include a quad-core processor, 8GB RAM, and Windows 7, 10, or 11.

title: Work Hours
content: Work is flexible. You can work 2 to 8 hours per day or 10 to 20 days per month, with a required minimum of 40 hours per monthly cycle.

title: Salary and Pay
content: The base rate is $2 per 800 qualified features. Experienced workers can earn around $3 to $6 or more per hour. Payments are released every 4 weeks.

title: Charges and Fees
content: Fees include a 4% service fee, ₱115 management fee, and 12% admin fee.

title: Training Process
content: Training takes around 2 days and includes a Pre-course Exam, rules and guidelines, and actual labeling tasks. Note: Live training sessions are temporarily stopped.

title: Training Videos
content: Training includes basic labeling (basics, techniques, switching, overview) and 3D labeling (basic 3D, drawing lines, overview).

title: #09 Training Schedule and Answer Key
content: Live training sessions are currently TEMPORARILY STOPPED. For more guides and self-study materials, please refer to the Answer Key Document.

title: How to Install
content: Install 7-Zip, extract Visual-C-Runtimes-All-in-One.zip, then run Install_all.bat to complete the setup.

title: #10 How to Login the Software
content: Step 1: Open 'ginger-2018.exe', choose 'Agree', and enter your Ginger ID and Password. If prompted to update, let it finish and restart Ginger. Step 2: Start Hands-on Training by pressing the 'Arrow Down' or Download icon on the upper left.

title: Account Registration
content: Accounts are automatically generated after passing the Pre-course Exam. If you cannot register, you need to retake the exam.

title: #12 Verification Form
content: Only fill out the Verification Form if you receive the 'Congratulations' pop-up after downloading a task. If you haven't received it, check for push-backed tasks from checkers and fix them until you get the pop-up.

title: Troubleshooting
content: If errors occur, redownload files, move them to Drive C, disable antivirus, restart your internet, and update Windows.

title: #11 Community and Support
content: Join the XF Trainees Facebook group at https://www.facebook.com/groups/xftraining and join the community chat for help and updates.

title: Workflow Summary
content: Process: Pre-course Exam, account generation, software installation, login, training, verification, then start working.

title: Cannot Open Bitmappro Account
content: Kindly wait for Cedrick to register your account. You may check the status of your account in your Account Generator file.

title: Invalid Ginger ID and Password Error
content: Make sure you followed step #04 and double-check for extra spaces. To be sure, copy and paste your Ginger ID and password directly from Bitmappro when logging in.

title: Software Installation Errors
content: Redownload all files, make a 'New Folder' under your 'Drive C:', and move all software files there. Temporarily disable your antivirus, restart your WiFi router, and if the error persists, update Windows via settings and restart.

title: Ginger Software Update Failed
content: Restart your WiFi router for at least 1 minute, restart your PC, open Control Panel, change the timezone to +8 Singapore.

title: Red and Yellow Lines (Topology Errors)
content: These are likely Topology errors. To remove them, fix the errors or redo the label, then press 'CTRL+T'. If the task was pushed back by a checker, some lines may remain but are okay if you follow the checker's comments.

title: Is Xfinite Legit?
content: Yes! We have been operating since 2017 with around 6,000 members. We do not collect registration fees, and you are free to stop if you feel this work isn't for you.

title: #13 Rules and Guidelines
content: After filling out the verification form, you can start the Rules and Guidelines. The link is password-protected. Cedrick Sabrine will provide the password after verifying your account. If he hasn't responded for more than 6 hours, you can message him with a screenshot of your results.

title: Minimum Payout
content: ₱1,500 per cut-off. Unclaimed payouts carry over to the next cut-off.

title: Cut-off Schedule:
content: 15th and 30th of the month. Posting every 5th and 20th of next month.

title: Distribution
content: Every 10th and 25th of each month.

title: Example
content: If you start working Oct 1–15, first payout will be listed Nov 5.

title: Application Process
content: If you accept the job expectations enumerated, we may proceed with your application.

title: service charge
content: Xfnite deducts service charge, but you don't need to pay any registration fee or activation fee, this is a legit actual job paying since 2017.

title: rates
content: Rates vary depending on work hours, speed, performance, or output. $1-$4+/hour, if you are confident that you are fast learning or a gamer. you can reach $4+/hour rate in no time.

title: payment interval
content: Payment is TWICE A MONTH! Xfnite is advertised as a PART-TIME JOB or for those looking for an extra income, if you are looking for a stable job to cater your daily needs, you might not belong here.

title: Follow The Steps Below to Apply! and Start working ASAP
ARE YOU READY TO START? Follow The Steps Below to Apply! and Start working ASAP
content: The application process consists of five simple steps to help you get started as soon as possible. First, like the Facebook page to show support and optionally invite your friends. Next, share the opportunity by posting it to your friends and relatives. Then, join the official training Facebook group and community chat to stay connected. After that, subscribe to the YouTube channel to gain access to training videos and live sessions. Finally, complete the application form by taking the pre-course exam to finalize your application and begin.

title: Salary payment method
content: The salary payment system offers multiple options for receiving earnings from Xfinite, with expected monthly income ranging from ₱1,000 to ₱30,000 depending on work hours, quality, and speed. Payments can be received through several channels, including BPI and Landbank with a ₱10 charge, as well as BDO, GCash, Metrobank, and other banks like CIMB, RCBC, and UnionBank, each with a ₱15 transaction fee.
